subject_definitions:
<Subject 1> is the single East Asian male protagonist defined by <Picture 1>, with tied-up black hair, a short beard and moustache, weathered skin, forehead and cheek scars, a serious calm expression, worn layered clothing, dark trousers, leather bracers, and a sheathed sword. Preserve his identity, face, clothing, hands, and body proportions.
<Subject 2> is the nighttime camp-cooking gameplay scene from <Picture 2>, including the protagonist positioned on the left, the horizontal skewer, one browned roasted meat portion, the lower-center campfire, sparks, smoke, dark blue forest, and the complete cooking HUD.
<Picture 2> is the fixed-camera composition and visual anchor for the entire 15-second cooking video.

summary:
[reference generation] Generate one 15-second, 16:9 realistic AAA camp-cooking gameplay video using <Picture 1> for the protagonist and <Picture 2> for the nighttime environment, composition, roasted meat, and cooking HUD. The player controls the protagonist to finish roasting the meat, take it from the skewer, and eat it. The corresponding meat item and cooking interaction indicators illuminate during the action. Use one completely fixed camera. No pan, tilt, zoom, dolly, tracking, orbit, handheld shake, or camera repositioning.

retention_analysis:
<Subject 1> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the protagonist's face, hair, scars, beard, clothing, hands, body proportions, and position on the left.
<Subject 2> (appears throughout [Shot 1]): fully_preserved - preserve the night forest, fire, skewer, roasted meat, smoke, sparks, HUD panels, lighting, and fixed viewpoint.
<Picture 2> ([Shot 1] fixed-camera composition): fully_preserved - retain the reference framing, fire placement, meat position, HUD layout, and low-key lighting while adding only the requested cooking and eating motion.

detailed_description:
The target video is a grounded AAA open-world gameplay capture with a completely locked-off camera matching <Picture 2>. The scene uses dark blue nighttime shadows, warm orange firelight, realistic smoke and sparks, worn fabric and leather textures, translucent black HUD panels, thin antique-gold borders, and restrained Chinese interface text. The camera must not move at any point.

[Shot 1] The video opens with <Subject 1> positioned on the left beside the lower-center campfire. The horizontal skewer holds one large browned piece of roasted meat directly above the flames. The upper-left “营火烹饪” instruction panel, right-side roast-meat information panel, and lower-right controls remain visible exactly as in <Picture 2>.

From 00:00 to 00:04, the player continues roasting the meat. The protagonist slowly rotates the skewer once. The meat glistens, fat reflects the firelight, smoke rises, and sparks drift upward. From 00:04 to 00:06, the player activates the cooking interaction. The roast-meat thumbnail and the “烤肉” item state in the right-side panel pulse with a warm-gold highlight. At the same moment, the “烹饪 E” control in the lower-right HUD lights up clearly. The other controls, “切换配方 R” and “离开 F”, remain unlit.

From 00:06 to 00:11, the protagonist removes the cooked meat from the skewer, raises it with both hands, and takes one clear bite. The eating action must be unmistakable and player-controlled, not merely an inspection gesture. His mouth opens naturally, the meat moves to his mouth, he bites, then lowers the remaining meat slightly. The camera remains fixed. From 00:11 to 00:15, he chews briefly and swallows while the fire continues burning. The “烤肉” thumbnail returns to its normal state after the bite, while the HUD remains stable. Do not add any new character, tent, lantern, pot, utensil, or extra meat.

overall_soundscape:
Campfire crackle, sizzling meat, skewer movement, smoke and sparks, leather and cloth movement, a soft bite and chewing sound, swallowing, and a brief cooking-interaction click. No dialogue and no voice-over.

non_diegetic_music:
A restrained low-tempo frontier score with low strings, sparse plucked instruments, and very light percussion. Add a subtle musical accent when the “烹饪 E” indicator illuminates, but keep the fire and eating sounds clearly audible.
